### Health Analytics with R · Module 07: Geospatial & Spatial Epidemiology
***
**Learning objectives**
- Understand spatial autocorrelation: Tobler's First Law of Geography
- Build spatial weights matrices (queen contiguity, rook, distance-based, k-NN)
- Compute Global Moran's I and its significance via permutation
- Calculate Local Moran's I (LISA) to identify spatial clusters
- Produce cluster maps: High-High, Low-Low, High-Low, Low-High quadrants
- Interpret Moran scatterplots for health outcomes

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced  
**Libraries:** `sf`, `spdep`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`, `patchwork`

## 1. Setup & Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(42)
out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod07")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

spatial_smooth <- function(values, row_idx, col_idx, nrow, ncol, sigma = 2) {
  grid <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow, ncol = ncol)
  for (i in seq_along(values)) grid[row_idx[i], col_idx[i]] <- values[i]
  k <- ceiling(3 * sigma)
  xs <- (-k):k
  kern <- outer(dnorm(xs, sd = sigma), dnorm(xs, sd = sigma))
  kern <- kern / sum(kern)
  pad <- k
  gp <- matrix(0, nrow + 2 * pad, ncol + 2 * pad)
  gp[(pad + 1):(pad + nrow), (pad + 1):(pad + ncol)] <- grid
  out <- matrix(0, nrow, ncol)
  for (r in seq_len(nrow)) {
    for (c in seq_len(ncol)) {
      out[r, c] <- sum(gp[r:(r + 2 * k), c:(c + 2 * k)] * kern)
    }
  }
  mapply(function(r, c) out[r, c], row_idx, col_idx)
}

NROW <- 10; NCOL <- 20; N <- NROW * NCOL
row_idx <- rep(seq_len(NROW), each = NCOL)
col_idx <- rep(seq_len(NCOL), times = NROW)
lon <- -120 + (col_idx - 1) * 2.5 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3)
lat <- 28 + (row_idx - 1) * 2.0 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.2)
pct_poverty   <- 10 + 8 * rbeta(N, 2, 5) + 3 * sin(lon / 20)
pct_uninsured <- 8 + 6 * rbeta(N, 2, 4) + 0.3 * pct_poverty
pm25          <- 8 + 4 * rgamma(N, shape = 2, scale = 1)
population    <- as.integer(rlnorm(N, 10.5, 1.0))
spatial_risk  <- spatial_smooth(rnorm(N), row_idx, col_idx, NROW, NCOL, sigma = 2)
cvd_rate <- (180 + 1.2 * pct_poverty + 0.8 * pct_uninsured + 0.5 * pm25 +
               15 * spatial_risk + rnorm(N, 0, 12))
expected <- (cvd_rate / 100000) * population * 5
observed <- rpois(N, expected)
smr <- observed / pmax(expected, 1)

df <- tibble(
  county_id = sprintf("C%03d", seq_len(N) - 1),
  lon, lat, row = row_idx, col = col_idx,
  pct_poverty, pct_uninsured, pm25, population, cvd_rate,
  observed, expected, smr, spatial_risk
)
geoms <- Map(function(lo, la) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(lo - 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la + 1,
      lo - 1.25, la + 1, lo - 1.25, la - 1),
    ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE
  )))
}, df$lon, df$lat)
gdf <- st_sf(df, geometry = st_sfc(geoms, crs = 4326))
cat(sprintf("N=%d counties | CVD=%.1f/100k | Poverty=%.1f%%\n",
            N, mean(cvd_rate), mean(pct_poverty)))
```

## 2. Spatial Weights Matrix

A **spatial weights matrix W** encodes the neighbourhood structure:
- **Queen contiguity**: shares any boundary point or corner
- **Rook contiguity**: shares an edge only
- **Distance-based**: w_ij = 1 if distance < threshold
- **k-NN**: each unit connected to its k nearest neighbours
- **Inverse distance**: w_ij = 1/d_ij (continuous)

Row-standardisation: W* where each row sums to 1 (so W*x = spatial lag of x)

```{r}
# Queen / rook from the regular grid indices
build_grid_nb <- function(row_idx, col_idx, type = c("queen", "rook")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  n <- length(row_idx)
  nb <- vector("list", n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    dr <- abs(row_idx - row_idx[i])
    dc <- abs(col_idx - col_idx[i])
    if (type == "queen") {
      nbrs <- which(dr <= 1 & dc <= 1 & !(dr == 0 & dc == 0))
    } else {
      nbrs <- which(((dr == 1 & dc == 0) | (dr == 0 & dc == 1)))
    }
    nb[[i]] <- if (length(nbrs)) as.integer(nbrs) else 0L
  }
  class(nb) <- "nb"
  attr(nb, "region.id") <- as.character(seq_len(n))
  attr(nb, "type") <- type
  nb
}

nb_queen <- build_grid_nb(df$row, df$col, "queen")
lw_queen <- nb2listw(nb_queen, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

coords <- cbind(df$lon, df$lat)
nb_knn  <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 6))
lw_knn  <- nb2listw(nb_knn, style = "W")

# Distance threshold: twice the 90th percentile of nearest-neighbour distance
nn1 <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 1))
nn_d <- unlist(nbdists(nn1, coords))
thr  <- 2 * quantile(nn_d, 0.90)
nb_dist <- dnearneigh(coords, 0, thr)
lw_dist <- nb2listw(nb_dist, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Queen W: %dx%d | Mean neighbours: %.1f\n",
            N, N, mean(card(nb_queen))))
cat(sprintf("KNN W  : %dx%d | Mean neighbours: %.1f\n",
            N, N, mean(card(nb_knn))))
cat(sprintf("Dist W : %dx%d | Mean neighbours: %.1f\n",
            N, N, mean(card(nb_dist))))
```

## 3. Global Moran's I

```{r}
print_moran <- function(x, lw, label) {
  mt <- moran.test(x, lw, zero.policy = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
  mp <- moran.mc(x, lw, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
  tibble(
    variable = label,
    I        = unname(mt$estimate["Moran I statistic"]),
    E_I      = unname(mt$estimate["Expectation"]),
    z_score  = unname(mt$statistic),
    p_value  = mp$p.value
  )
}

moran_tab <- bind_rows(
  print_moran(df$cvd_rate, lw_queen, "CVD rate"),
  print_moran(df$pct_poverty, lw_queen, "Poverty (%)"),
  print_moran(df$smr, lw_queen, "SMR"),
  print_moran(df$pm25, lw_queen, "PM2.5")
)
print(moran_tab)

# Moran I for CVD rate (main analysis)
res_cvd <- moran.test(df$cvd_rate, lw_queen, zero.policy = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
mc_cvd  <- moran.mc(df$cvd_rate, lw_queen, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
I_cvd   <- unname(res_cvd$estimate["Moran I statistic"])
p_cvd   <- mc_cvd$p.value
e_cvd   <- unname(res_cvd$estimate["Expectation"])
```

```{r}
# Moran scatterplot (spdep::moran.plot) plus permutation histogram
z_cvd  <- as.numeric(scale(df$cvd_rate))
Wz_cvd <- lag.listw(lw_queen, z_cvd, zero.policy = TRUE)
quadrant <- case_when(
  z_cvd > 0 & Wz_cvd > 0 ~ "High-High",
  z_cvd < 0 & Wz_cvd < 0 ~ "Low-Low",
  z_cvd > 0 & Wz_cvd < 0 ~ "High-Low",
  TRUE                   ~ "Low-High"
)
quad_colors <- c(
  "High-High" = "#DC2626", "Low-Low" = "#2563EB",
  "High-Low" = "#AEC6CF", "Low-High" = "#F4A582"
)

p_scatter <- ggplot(tibble(z = z_cvd, Wz = Wz_cvd, q = quadrant), aes(z, Wz, colour = q)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              mapping = aes(z, Wz)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = quad_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardised CVD rate (z)", y = "Spatial lag (W*z)", colour = NULL,
    title = sprintf("Moran Scatterplot: CVD Rate\n(I=%.3f, p=%.4f)", I_cvd, p_cvd)
  )

p_perm <- ggplot(tibble(I = as.numeric(mc_cvd$res)), aes(I)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#AEC6CF", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = I_cvd, colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = e_cvd, colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Moran's I (permuted)", y = "Count",
    title = sprintf("Permutation Distribution (B=999)\np=%.4f", p_cvd)
  )

p_moran <- p_scatter | p_perm
print(p_moran)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "morans_i.png"), p_moran, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 150)

# Official Moran scatterplot from spdep
moran.plot(df$cvd_rate, lw_queen, labels = FALSE,
           xlab = "CVD rate", ylab = "Spatial lag of CVD rate",
           main = "spdep::moran.plot")
```

## 4. Local Moran's I (LISA)

```{r}
lisa <- localmoran(df$cvd_rate, lw_queen, zero.policy = TRUE)
gdf$lisa_i <- lisa[, "Ii"]
gdf$lisa_p <- lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]
z_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$cvd_rate))
z_lag <- lag.listw(lw_queen, z_std, zero.policy = TRUE)
quadrant_loc <- case_when(
  z_std > 0 & z_lag > 0 ~ "HH",
  z_std < 0 & z_lag < 0 ~ "LL",
  z_std > 0 & z_lag < 0 ~ "HL",
  TRUE                  ~ "LH"
)
gdf$lisa_cluster <- ifelse(gdf$lisa_p < 0.05, quadrant_loc, "NS")

cluster_colors <- c(
  HH = "#DC2626", LL = "#2563EB", HL = "#F4A582", LH = "#92C5DE", NS = "#E0E0E0"
)

p_lisa <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_cluster), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "LISA Cluster Map: CVD Mortality",
    subtitle = "HH=hot spots, LL=cold spots, HL/LH=outliers",
    fill = NULL, x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  )

sig_lab <- ifelse(gdf$lisa_p < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "NS")
p_sig <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = sig_lab), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = "#DC2626", NS = "#E0E0E0")) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf(
      "LISA Significance Map (p<0.05)\n%d significant counties (%.1f%%)",
      sum(gdf$lisa_p < 0.05), mean(gdf$lisa_p < 0.05) * 100
    ),
    fill = NULL, x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  )

p_lisa_both <- p_lisa | p_sig
print(p_lisa_both)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "lisa_cluster_map.png"), p_lisa_both,
       width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 150)

cat("LISA cluster summary:\n")
print(gdf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(lisa_cluster) %>%
        mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100))
```

## 5. Getis-Ord G* Hot Spot Analysis

```{r}
# G* includes self in the neighbourhood
lw_gstar <- nb2listw(include.self(nb_queen), style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
g_star <- localG(df$cvd_rate, lw_gstar, zero.policy = TRUE)
gdf$g_star   <- as.numeric(g_star)
gdf$g_star_p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(gdf$g_star))

gdf$hotspot_class <- case_when(
  gdf$g_star >  2.58 & gdf$g_star_p < 0.01 ~ "Hot spot 99%",
  gdf$g_star >  1.96 & gdf$g_star_p < 0.05 ~ "Hot spot 95%",
  gdf$g_star < -2.58 & gdf$g_star_p < 0.01 ~ "Cold spot 99%",
  gdf$g_star < -1.96 & gdf$g_star_p < 0.05 ~ "Cold spot 95%",
  TRUE                                     ~ "Not significant"
)
hs_colors <- c(
  "Hot spot 99%" = "#D73027", "Hot spot 95%" = "#FC8D59",
  "Cold spot 99%" = "#4575B4", "Cold spot 95%" = "#91BFDB",
  "Not significant" = "#E0E0E0"
)

p_hs <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = hotspot_class), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hs_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Getis-Ord G* Hot Spot Analysis: CVD Mortality",
    fill = NULL, x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  )
print(p_hs)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "getis_ord_gstar.png"), p_hs, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
print(table(gdf$hotspot_class))
```

## 6. Knowledge Check
1. Global Moran's I = 0.42 (p<0.001). Does this tell us *where* the spatial clusters are?
2. A LISA map shows an HL outlier (High-Low): a high CVD county surrounded by low-CVD counties. List three explanations.
3. You used queen contiguity weights. How would switching to k-NN (k=8) change the Moran's I estimate?
4. Why should LISA p-values be interpreted cautiously given that you're running 200 local tests?
5. Compute Moran's I for the *residuals* from an OLS regression of CVD on poverty. Interpret the result.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — Moran's I on OLS residuals
ols <- lm(cvd_rate ~ pct_poverty + pct_uninsured + pm25, data = df)
mt_ols <- moran.test(residuals(ols), lw_queen, zero.policy = TRUE)
mc_ols <- moran.mc(residuals(ols), lw_queen, nsim = 499, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Moran's I on CVD rate           : %.4f (p=%.4f)\n", I_cvd, p_cvd))
cat(sprintf("Moran's I on OLS residuals      : %.4f (p=%.4f)\n",
            unname(mt_ols$estimate["Moran I statistic"]), mc_ols$p.value))
if (mc_ols$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("Significant residual spatial autocorrelation -> OLS is biased!\n")
  cat("Need spatial regression models (spatial lag or spatial error).\n")
} else {
  cat("Residual spatial autocorrelation removed by covariate adjustment.\n")
}
```
